chapters.chapter_title: My Class Is Behind the Office

questions.text: Listen carefully. Where is the classroom?
questions.discussion: Audio menjawab bahwa ruang kelas berada di belakang kantor.

audio.text: Where is the classroom? It is behind the office.

questions.text: Listen carefully. Which place is beside the parking area?
questions.discussion: Audio menyatakan bahwa laboratorium berada di sebelah area parkir.

audio.text: The laboratory is beside the parking area.

questions.text: Listen carefully. Which place is in the middle?
questions.discussion: **Between** menempatkan kantor di tengah perpustakaan dan ruang kelas.

audio.text: The office is between the library and the classroom.

questions.text: Listen carefully. Where is the bag?
questions.discussion: Audio menyebutkan dengan jelas bahwa tas berada di bawah meja.

audio.text: The bag is under the desk, not on the desk.

questions.text: Listen carefully. Which sentence matches the audio?
options: The gate is behind the school.
The gate is beside the school.
The gate is in front of the school.
The gate is under the school.
questions.answer: The gate is in front of the school.
questions.discussion: Audio menjawab bahwa gerbang berada di depan sekolah.

audio.text: Where is the gate? It is in front of the school.
